newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat closes higher on corn/soybean rally.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat closes higher on corn/soybean rally.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures closed higher on a rally in corn and soybean futures, traders said.
"It was just the corn and bean rally," said Vic Lespinasse of Dean Witter Reynolds.

Gains were limited by news Egypt over the weekend bought 200,000 tonnes of wheat from France, more than the 150,000 tonnes it bought from the United States. Rumors circulated late Friday that Egypt over the weekend would be in the market for U.S. wheat.
Also gains were limited by nearly-ideal harvesting weather in the U.S. spring wheat growing region.
Wheat futures volume was estimated at 18,000, up from 11,024 Friday.
In wheat options, Refco Inc sold 200 December $4.70 puts at 26 to 26-1/2 cents, traders said.
Wheat options volume was estimated at 2,500 contracts, down from 4,074 Friday.
Wheat closed four to 7-1/4 cents per bushel higher, with September up 6-1/2 at $4.59-1/4 a bushel.
